pairs.target: chūfā nàtiān , tǎ wéi bǎ wàzi chuān fǎn le , zǒu dào ménkǒu cái juéde jiǎogēn bièniu .
pairs.english: On departure morning, Tavi put his socks on inside out and only noticed his heel felt wrong when he reached the door.
pairs.hanzi: 出发那天，塔维把袜子穿反了，走到门口才觉得脚跟别扭。

alignment.english: put his socks on inside out

pairs.target: pà wò zuòzài chuángshàng kàn tā tuōxié , shuō lù hái méi kāishǐ , rén yǐjīng yào xiū yíbiàn .
pairs.english: Pavo watched from his bed and said the journey hadn't begun, but its traveler already needed repairs.
pairs.hanzi: 帕沃坐在床上看他脱鞋，说路还没开始，人已经要修一遍。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ wàzi fān zhèng , méi gēn tā zhēng , zhī bǎ liúzài zhuōshàng de bànkuài bǐng ná huílái .
pairs.english: Tavi righted his socks without arguing, then retrieved the half piece of bread he had left on the table.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把袜子翻正，没跟他争，只把留在桌上的半块饼拿回来。

pairs.target: wàimiàn jiǎn lǎoshī yǐjīng diǎn guò yìlún míngzì ,
pairs.english: Outside, Instructor Jian had already called the names once.
pairs.hanzi: 外面简老师已经点过一轮名字，

pairs.target: yīwén tì tā jǔ le yíxiàshǒu , shuō rén zài , búshì míngzì zìjǐ lái de .
pairs.english: Iven raised a hand for him, saying the person was here, not just a name that had arrived on its own.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文替他举了一下手，说人在，不是名字自己来的。

pairs.target: tāmen yán chéng biān de yìlù wǎng wài zǒu .
pairs.english: They followed the post road out along the city's edge.
pairs.hanzi: 他们沿城边的驿路往外走。

pairs.target: zuìchū háiyǒu pùzi , mài rèshuǐ de nǚrén zhèng wǎng tǒng lǐ tiānshuǐ , yígè xiǎohái dūn zài ménkǎn shàng shù lǎoshī dài le duōshǎo xuéshēng .
pairs.english: At first there were still shops. A woman selling hot water topped up a bucket while a child crouched on a threshold, counting the students with the teachers.
pairs.hanzi: 最初还有铺子，卖热水的女人正往桶里添水，一个小孩蹲在门槛上数老师带了多少学生。

pairs.target: zài guòqù , wūdǐng biàn ǎi , shíqiáng duànkāi , lùpáng zhī shèng jǐgēn bèi shéngzi mó dé fāliàng de shuān zhuāng .
pairs.english: Farther on, roofs grew lower and stone walls ended, leaving only roadside tethering posts polished by ropes.
pairs.hanzi: 再过去，屋顶变矮，石墙断开，路旁只剩几根被绳子磨得发亮的拴桩。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bèizhe yíbàn liángjù , tīngjiàn xiāng lǐ zhǐbǎn qīngqīng pèng mù bì .
pairs.english: Tavi carried half the instruments, hearing card tap softly against the wooden box walls.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维背着一半量具，听见箱里纸板轻轻碰木壁。

pairs.target: tā zhīdào lǐmiàn měiyíjiàn fàngzài nǎlǐ , háishì zǒu jǐbù jiù xiǎng yòng shǒufú yíxià .
pairs.english: He knew where every item was, yet wanted to steady the box every few steps.
pairs.hanzi: 他知道里面每一件放在哪里，还是走几步就想用手扶一下。

pairs.target: shào lǐ bèizhe jiào zhòng de xiāngzǐ , zǒu zài qiánmiàn , huítóu jiào tāmen bié bǎ duìwu tuōcháng .
pairs.english: Shaoli walked ahead with the heavier box and called back for them not to let the group stretch out.
pairs.hanzi: 邵里背着较重的箱子，走在前面，回头叫他们别把队伍拖长。

pairs.target: jiǎn lǎoshī què zài yíkuài lù bēi páng tíngxià , děng hòumiàn de rén dào qí cái zǒu .
pairs.english: But Instructor Jian stopped at a milestone and waited for the rear to catch up before continuing.
pairs.hanzi: 简老师却在一块路碑旁停下，等后面的人到齐才走。

pairs.target: mǐlā bǎ bēi shàng de jiù zì chāoxiàlái , yīwén jì chàlù .
pairs.english: Mira copied the stone's old writing, while Iven recorded the fork in the road.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉把碑上的旧字抄下来，伊文记岔路。

pairs.target: zhǐ shàng de lù cóng liǎnggè shāntóu zhōngjiān chuānguò , jiǎoxià què zǒng zài rào ,
pairs.english: On paper, the road passed between two peaks, but underfoot it kept winding.
pairs.hanzi: 纸上的路从两个山头中间穿过，脚下却总在绕，

pairs.target: míngmíng kànjiàn duìmiàn de pō , zǒu le hǎojiǔ yě méi gèng jìn .
pairs.english: The opposite slope was plainly visible, yet seemed no closer after a long walk.
pairs.hanzi: 明明看见对面的坡，走了好久也没更近。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi wèn shìbushì túhuà duǎn le ,
pairs.english: Tavi asked whether the map had made the road too short.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维问是不是图画短了，

pairs.target: yīwén táiqǐ běnzi , zhé le yíxià , ràng zhǐbiān qǐfú qǐlái ,
pairs.english: Iven lifted his book and folded it so the paper rose and fell.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文抬起本子，折了一下，让纸边起伏起来，

pairs.target: shuō yàoshi lián pō dōu huà dé tóngyàng cháng , zìjǐ dé bèi yíjuàn pūchuáng de zhǐ .
pairs.english: He said that if every slope were drawn to the same length too, he would need a roll of paper big enough to make a bed.
pairs.hanzi: 说要是连坡都画得同样长，自己得背一卷铺床的纸。

alignment.english: big enough to make a bed

pairs.target: mǐlā shuō nà dǎo néng shùnbiàn shuì , sāngè rén xiào le yízhèn , yòu jiànjiàn bù shuōhuà le .
pairs.english: Mira said he could sleep on it as well. They laughed for a while, then gradually fell silent.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉说那倒能顺便睡，三个人笑了一阵，又渐渐不说话了。

pairs.target: fēng cóng zuìhòu yìpái wūdǐng hòumiàn guòlái , dài zhe shī mùtou de wèidào , chénglǐ de guō yān bèi liúzài bèihòu .
pairs.english: Wind came from beyond the last roofs, smelling of wet wood, leaving the city's cooking smoke behind.
pairs.hanzi: 风从最后一排屋顶后面过来，带着湿木头的味道，城里的锅烟被留在背后。

pairs.target: dào le lǐng jiān , yǎnqián hūrán méiyǒu dōngxī dǎng zhe .
pairs.english: At the shoulder of the ridge, suddenly nothing blocked the view.
pairs.hanzi: 到了岭肩，眼前忽然没有东西挡着。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiān kànjiàn yún . búshì táitóu kàn de nàzhǒng ,
pairs.english: Tavi saw clouds first. These were not clouds he had to look up at.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维先看见云。不是抬头看的那种，

pairs.target: yún zài jiǎoxià gèng yuǎn de gǔ lǐ , píngpù dào lìng yìchóng shānbiān , biānyuán mànmàn fān qǐlái , xiàng yǒurén cóng xiàmiàn dǒu yíkuài kànbúdào tóu de bù .
pairs.english: They lay in the distant valley below, spread flat to another mountain range, their edges slowly turning upward like an endless cloth shaken from underneath.
pairs.hanzi: 云在脚下更远的谷里，平铺到另一重山边，边缘慢慢翻起来，像有人从下面抖一块看不到头的布。

pairs.target: jǐgēn shēnsè de fēng jǐ chuānguò bái chù , jìn de xiàng shíqiáng , yuǎn de xì dé xiàng jùchǐ .
pairs.english: Dark ridges pierced the white, the near ones like stone walls, the distant ones fine as saw teeth.
pairs.hanzi: 几根深色的峰脊穿过白处，近的像石墙，远的细得像锯齿。

pairs.target: tā bǎ xiāng dài zhuājǐn le yìdiǎn , jiǎo què méi wǎngqián nuó .
pairs.english: He tightened his grip on the carrying strap but did not step forward.
pairs.hanzi: 他把箱带抓紧了一点，脚却没往前挪。

pairs.target: lù wài yǒu ǎi lán , lán xià shì dǒupō , tā zhàn zài lù zhōngjiān yě juéde wèi lǐ kōng le yíxià .
pairs.english: A low railing bordered the steep slope beyond the road. Even standing in the middle, his stomach seemed to hollow out.
pairs.hanzi: 路外有矮栏，栏下是陡坡，他站在路中间也觉得胃里空了一下。

pairs.target: mǐlā méiyǒu shuō tā dǎnxiǎo , tā yě wǎnglǐmiàn kào le kào , téngchū wàicè ràng yìtóu tuó chái de luózǐ guòqù .
pairs.english: Mira did not call him timid. She moved inward too, leaving the outside for a mule laden with firewood.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉没有说他胆小，她也往里面靠了靠，腾出外侧让一头驮柴的骡子过去。

pairs.target: fēng bǎ yún tuīkāi yìtiáo fèng . dǐxià lùchū hěn shēn de lǜ , zhōngjiān yǒu yídào fāliàng de wān hén ,
pairs.english: The wind opened a gap in the clouds, revealing deep green below and a shining curve within it.
pairs.hanzi: 风把云推开一条缝。底下露出很深的绿，中间有一道发亮的弯痕，

pairs.target: cái kànqīng yìdiǎn , yòu bèi báisè gài huíqù .
pairs.english: Just as it became clear, white covered it again.
pairs.hanzi: 才看清一点，又被白色盖回去。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi hái méi láidejí wèn shìbushì hé , jiǎn lǎoshī yǐjīng zhāohū tāmen jìxù zǒu .
pairs.english: Before Tavi could ask whether it was the river, Instructor Jian called them onward.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维还没来得及问是不是河，简老师已经招呼他们继续走。

pairs.target: jīntiān yǒu jīntiān de lù , bùnéng zài měiyíchù dōu tíng dào yún kěn ràngkāi .
pairs.english: They had today's road to walk; they could not stop everywhere until the clouds consented to move.
pairs.hanzi: 今天有今天的路，不能在每一处都停到云肯让开。

pairs.target: jiù hòuchē péng jiù zài lǐng jiān lìngyícè , bèikào shíbì , yán xiàpù zhe kuān mùbǎn , wàitou guà le yímiàn bǔguò de lán qí .
pairs.english: The old waiting shelter stood on the ridge's other side, against a rock wall, with broad boards under its eaves and a patched blue flag outside.
pairs.hanzi: 旧候车棚就在岭肩另一侧，背靠石壁，檐下铺着宽木板，外头挂了一面补过的蓝旗。

pairs.target: péng biān de lù jìxù xiàxíng , guǎiguò jǐdào pō yǐhòu biàn kànbújiàn le .
pairs.english: The road continued downhill beside it and vanished beyond several bends.
pairs.hanzi: 棚边的路继续下行，拐过几道坡以后便看不见了。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi kànzhe nàtiáo lù , hūrán juéde chéng búshì shìjiè de shàngtóu , zhǐshì tāmen gāng cóng nàlǐ zǒu chūlái .
pairs.english: Looking at that road, Tavi suddenly felt the city was not the top of the world, merely the place they had just left.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维看着那条路，忽然觉得城不是世界的上头，只是他们刚从那里走出来。

pairs.target: pénglǐ yǐjīng zuò zhe rén . liǎngmíng yùnhuò gōng zài bǔ yìtiáo lièkāi de bǎngdài ,
pairs.english: People were already inside. Two freight workers repaired a split strap.
pairs.hanzi: 棚里已经坐着人。两名运货工在补一条裂开的绑带，

pairs.target: yígè lǎotàitài bǎ jīlóng jiá zài tuǐ biān , jiàn xuéshēng guòlái , xiān ná jiǎo dǎngzhù lóng mén .
pairs.english: An old woman held a chicken basket between her legs and blocked its door with her foot as the students approached.
pairs.hanzi: 一个老太太把鸡笼夹在腿边，见学生过来，先拿脚挡住笼门。

pairs.target: shào lǐ bǎ xiāngzǐ wǎng cháng zhuōshàng yí fàng , jiào tāmen bǎ kōng chù ràng yìdiǎn , shuō xuégōng jīntiān jièyòng .
pairs.english: Shaoli set his box on the long table and asked them to make space, saying the academy was using it today.
pairs.hanzi: 邵里把箱子往长桌上一放，叫他们把空处让一点，说学宫今天借用。

pairs.target: yùnhuò gōng méiyǒu nuó . tā cóng yīlǐng lǐ chōuchū yìzhāng zhéjiù de hòu chēpiào , zhǐzhǐ péngwài de lán qí ,
pairs.english: The freight worker did not move. He pulled a worn ticket from his collar and pointed at the blue flag outside.
pairs.hanzi: 运货工没有挪。他从衣领里抽出一张折旧的候车票，指指棚外的蓝旗，

pairs.target: shuō chē hái méi dào , zìjǐ yě zài děng zhe yòng .
pairs.english: He said the cart had not come, and he too was waiting to use the shelter.
pairs.hanzi: 说车还没到，自己也在等着用。

pairs.target: tā shēngyīn bù gāo , shào lǐ de liǎn què lìkè bēng le .
pairs.english: His voice was quiet, but Shaoli's face immediately tightened.
pairs.hanzi: 他声音不高，邵里的脸却立刻绷了。

pairs.target: jiǎn lǎoshī zǒujìn lái , bǎ jièyòng de zhǐ nágěi shǒu péng de rén kàn .
pairs.english: Instructor Jian entered and showed the borrowing document to the shelter keeper.
pairs.hanzi: 简老师走进来，把借用的纸拿给守棚的人看。

pairs.target: nà shì gè jiānbǎng kuānhòu de nǚrén , xiùkǒu zhā dé jǐn , yāo biān guà zhe yíchuàn mùpái .
pairs.english: She was a broad-shouldered woman with tight cuffs and a string of wooden tags at her waist.
pairs.hanzi: 那是个肩膀宽厚的女人，袖口扎得紧，腰边挂着一串木牌。

pairs.target: tā dúwán shuō shì jiè bèifēng de yìjiǎo , búshì bǎ hòuchē de rén gǎnchūqù .
pairs.english: After reading it, she said they had borrowed a sheltered corner, not the right to drive waiting travelers out.
pairs.hanzi: 她读完说是借背风的一角，不是把候车的人赶出去。

pairs.target: chángzhuō háiyào liúgěi kǔn huò , xuéshēng de ǎi zhuō zài lǐmiàn , yào bān jiù zìjǐ bān .
pairs.english: The long table was for tying cargo. The students' low table was inside; they could move it themselves.
pairs.hanzi: 长桌还要留给捆货，学生的矮桌在里面，要搬就自己搬。

pairs.target: shào lǐ zhāng le zhāngzuǐ , háishì bǎ xiāngzǐ tí qǐlái .
pairs.english: Shaoli opened his mouth, then picked up the box anyway.
pairs.hanzi: 邵里张了张嘴，还是把箱子提起来。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi gēnzhe zǒujìn qù , liǎng rén yìqiányīhòu bǎ ǎi zhuō táichūlái , fàngzài kào shíbì de kōng chù .
pairs.english: Tavi followed him inside. Together, one at each end, they carried the low table out to the clear space beside the rock wall.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维跟着走进去，两人一前一后把矮桌抬出来，放在靠石壁的空处。

pairs.target: zhuōjiǎo yìgāoyìdī , dǐxià diàn le piàn mùtou cái wěn . tāmen dōu chū le hàn , fēng yì chuī , bèishàng yòu liáng .
pairs.english: The legs were uneven; a piece of wood underneath steadied it. Both were sweating, then the wind chilled their backs.
pairs.hanzi: 桌脚一高一低，底下垫了片木头才稳。他们都出了汗，风一吹，背上又凉。

pairs.target: shǒu péng de nǚrén dì lái yìhúshuǐ , shuō bié ná liángjù hé diànjiǎo ,
pairs.english: The keeper brought a jug of water and told them not to use instrument cases under the legs.
pairs.hanzi: 守棚的女人递来一壶水，说别拿量具盒垫脚，

pairs.target: qùnián yǒurén bǎ zìjǐ zuò de dèngzǐ dōu jì jìn le huòdān .
pairs.english: Last year someone had even entered his own stool on the cargo manifest.
pairs.hanzi: 去年有人把自己坐的凳子都记进了货单。

pairs.target: mǐlā xiào chū shēng , shào lǐ méi xiào , què jiēguò hú dào le xiè .
pairs.english: Mira laughed aloud. Shaoli did not laugh, but accepted the jug and thanked her.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉笑出声，邵里没笑，却接过壶道了谢。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zuòxià shí , tīngjiàn yuǎnchù yǒu yìshēng zhōng .
pairs.english: As Tavi sat down, he heard a distant bell.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维坐下时，听见远处有一声钟。

pairs.target: gé dé hěn yuǎn , shēngyīn xiān báobáodì lái , guò yíhuìer fǎngfú yòu cóng biéde shānbì huí le yícì .
pairs.english: The sound came thinly from far away, then seemed to return from another mountain wall after a while.
pairs.hanzi: 隔得很远，声音先薄薄地来，过一会儿仿佛又从别的山壁回了一次。

pairs.target: lǎotàitài bǎ jīlóng wǎng huáilǐ shōujǐn , yùnhuò gōng tíng le zhēn , cèěr tīng dìèrshēng .
pairs.english: The old woman tightened her hold on the chicken basket. The freight worker stopped his needle and listened for the second note.
pairs.hanzi: 老太太把鸡笼往怀里收紧，运货工停了针，侧耳听第二声。

pairs.target: shǒu péng de rén zǒu dào yán biān kàn lán qí .
pairs.english: The keeper went to the eaves to check the blue flag.
pairs.hanzi: 守棚的人走到檐边看蓝旗。

pairs.target: tā shuō búshì zhèbiān de chē , děng xià yìlún .
pairs.english: She said it was not their cart; they must wait for the next round.
pairs.hanzi: 她说不是这边的车，等下一轮。

pairs.target: dàjiā yòu gè zuò gè de , zhǐyǒu tǎ wéi hái dīng zhe kànbújiàn de lù .
pairs.english: Everyone returned to their own tasks. Only Tavi kept watching the unseen road.
pairs.hanzi: 大家又各做各的，只有塔维还盯着看不见的路。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī bǎ qìcái qīngdān fàngzài zhuōshàng , jiào tā xiān dǎkāi zìjǐ de xiāngzǐ .
pairs.english: Instructor Vey set the equipment list on the table and told him to open his own box first.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师把器材清单放在桌上，叫他先打开自己的箱子。

pairs.target: tā jiěkāi dàizǐ , shǒuzhǐ mō dào gānzào de zhǐ jiǎo , hūrán juéde wūlǐ xué guò de nàxiē xìxiǎo dōngxī , jìng zhēnde néng bèi bèi dào zhème yuǎn de dìfāng lái .
pairs.english: He undid the straps, touched a dry paper corner, and suddenly felt that the little things he had learned indoors really could be carried this far.
pairs.hanzi: 他解开带子，手指摸到干燥的纸角，忽然觉得屋里学过的那些细小东西，竟真的能被背到这么远的地方来。
